items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: I was working at the Jazz Limited in Chicago... I went over with Sammy Price. We made the same, about the same tour -- in Paris, France.

ctx.x: Or you just happened to be in Chicago for a while?
Well, when I went to Jazz Limited the first time, that's when Sammy Price contacted me. I think we had one or two rehearsals here. We had Jimmy Archey, myself, Pops Foster, Mezzrow, Lee Collins...

items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: He recorded under that name, and apparently on December 29, 1955, he recorded with you... How long were you with Sam Price? ... Just that tour, yes.

ctx.x: Now, with Sam Price, Sam Price and His Bluesicians. He recorded under that name, and apparently on December 29, 1955, he recorded with you, Pops Foster, Herbie Hill...
